description: Repairs r-def-cursor-dao/edit-under-commit: the second cursor ro shared the session and the transaction, so 'visibility to a second cursor' was same-session only. A second, appended Workspace W2 holds a read-write Database db2 on the same file. A dynaset rs over "SELECT ID, N FROM T ORDER BY ID" opened before BeginTrans: BeginTrans; Edit row 1, assign N 11, Update, EditMode; AddNew ID 20 N 200, Update; MoveFirst, MoveNext, Delete, read BOF, EOF and ID; RecordCount; a second dynaset ro in the same Workspace read to EOF (the original control); a dynaset rx opened through db2 in W2 and read to EOF, then closed; CommitTrans; read rs RecordCount, BOF, EOF, ID and EditMode without Requery; Requery and read all rows; a fresh snapshot in the first Workspace and another through db2 read all rows. Asks the visibility of the edits to a cursor in another Workspace before and after CommitTrans, and the state of the held cursor after the commit. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
